test_MessageToString: test the python text_format.MessageToString to serialize a protobuf message to human-readable text format
test_Merge: test the python text_format.Merge to parse human-readable text format into a protobuf message object
test_ParseError: test the python text_format.ParseError exception raised when merging invalid text format input
test_Tokenizer: test the python text_format._Tokenizer to tokenize identifiers, strings, integers, floats, and booleans from text
test_MessageSet: test the python text_format.MessageToString and Merge with protobuf MessageSet extension fields
